verdict.rationale: Reducto documents a Split endpoint that finds which pages hold which sections of a document, using sections you describe in natural language. It also has a Classify endpoint for document types, and one upload ID can be passed to Classify, Split, Parse or Extract. Multi-step workflows chain classification, parsing and extraction into single API calls, but no source shows split segments being classified and processed into per-document results automatically from one upload. Missing for 10: documented split-to-per-document extraction chaining, per-segment classification of packets, Split listed explicitly in the workflow/pipeline chain, independent or hands-on corroboration of packet splitting.

support.subject: As a data engineer, multi-document packets are classified and split automatically — one upload, per-document results

citations.quote: Split identifies which pages contain which sections of a document. You describe sections in natural language, and Reducto returns the page numbers where each section lives.
Classify determines what kind of document you are looking at before any downstream processing begins.
returning a unique `reducto://` identifier you can pass to any downstream endpoint: Classify, Parse, Split, Extract, or Edit.
Multi-step workflows that chain classification, parsing, extraction, and editing into single API calls
